prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production animation correction, not a character redesign.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an 18-frame Kazi run sheet. Image 2 is the identity and long slim curved sword STYLE REFERENCE.
Preserve the exact illustrated character, face/hair, charcoal split coat, white collar, gold buttons, trousers, boots, purple sparks, long thin curved sword, weapon hand and north west (back-left) viewing direction. Change only the RUN gait.
The present feet appear to glide beneath his hips. Redraw a real grounded run-in-place cycle: EXACTLY 6 equal columns by 3 equal rows, exactly 18 separate occupied cells, one character per cell, left-to-right then top-to-bottom. TWO opposing footfalls in one full loop. Never hold the same leg pose for several frames.
Frame 0 LEFT heel contact: left boot reaches FORWARD about one-quarter standing body height from hips, right leg bent behind. Frames 1,2,3,4,5: the SAME planted left boot moves steadily BACKWARD relative to the hips in evenly spaced increments until rear toe-off. Its sole stays on ONE common floor baseline through stance. Frames 6,7,8: left knee folds and boot recovers forward through the air. Frame 9 RIGHT heel contact, opposite legs. Frames 10,11,12,13,14: planted right boot traverses steadily backward to rear toe-off on the SAME floor baseline. Frames 15,16,17: right knee folds and boot recovers forward. Frame 17 leads smoothly to frame 0. This is a full stride with actual forward heel reach and backward planted-foot travel, not repeated feet directly under the torso. In front/back views foreshorten this exact same gait appropriately.
Keep hip and head centers nearly fixed with only a tiny natural bob (less than 1.5% of standing body height). Natural forward lean; no hopping, exaggerated bounce, moonwalk, floating, foot skating, or camera/scale changes. Relaxed counter-swing in the free arm; blade stays safely in its existing hand with the SAME thin curved shape and length. Preserve style and identity strictly.
All 18 cells use the same body scale, head height and floor baseline relative to their own cell; all six columns and all three rows use identical registration. Fit the entire character, extended limbs, longer sword and ALL sparks comfortably INSIDE each cell with at least 20 transparent pixels clear at EVERY edge. Reduce the whole character uniformly if necessary; do not crop limbs or blade. True transparent alpha zero background, NO gray haze, NO ground shadow, NO text, labels, grid lines, extra cells, or watermark. Same canvas aspect as image 1.
